import cv2, numpy as np

# Camera intrinsics
fov = np.deg2rad(90)
f = 256.0 / np.tan(fov / 2.0)  # f = 256.0
cx = 255.5
cy = 255.5
cam_h = 1.55  # camera height in meters

# Floor lamp base contact:
# In obs_13: base center x, y
# Let's isolate the base in obs_13:
img13 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0013.png')
base_mask_13 = (img13[:,:,0] < 100) & (img13[:,:,1] < 90) & (img13[:,:,2] < 90) & (np.arange(512)[:,None] > 350) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 180) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] < 260)
y13, x13 = np.where(base_mask_13)
print('obs 13 base center:', x13.mean(), y13.mean(), 'bottom y:', y13.max())

# In obs_18:
img18 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0018.png')
base_mask_18 = (img18[:,:,0] < 100) & (img18[:,:,1] < 90) & (img18[:,:,2] < 90) & (np.arange(512)[:,None] > 350) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 270) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] < 350)
y18, x18 = np.where(base_mask_18)
print('obs 18 base center:', x18.mean(), y18.mean(), 'bottom y:', y18.max())

# Ground contact distance from camera height:
# If camera is at height 1.55, tilt is 0 (horizontal optical axis):
# Then y_pixel = cy + f * (cam_h - 0) / z_cam = 255.5 + 256 * 1.55 / z_cam
# So z_cam = 256 * 1.55 / (y_bottom - 255.5)
z13_floor = 256 * 1.55 / (y13.max() - 255.5)
z18_floor = 256 * 1.55 / (y18.max() - 255.5)
print(f'z13: {z13_floor:.2f} m, z18: {z18_floor:.2f} m')
"
